info.title: Onfleet Universal API
info.description: Manage drivers, teams, tasks, and deliveries with Onfleet

put.description: Assigns tasks to workers automatically in Onfleet.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

tasks[].description: An array of task IDs to assign.

options.mode.description: The desired automatic assignment mode. Either distance or load.

options.teams[].description: An array of team IDs to consider for automatic assignment.

options.maxAssignedTaskCount.description: The maximum number of tasks a worker can have after automatic assignment.

options.considerDependencies.description: Whether to include dependency families in the assignment operation.

options.excludedWorkerIds[].description: One or more worker IDs that should not be considered in assignment calculations.

options.restrictAutoAssignmentToTeam.description: Whether to restrict auto-assignment strictly to the provided teams.

skipPhoneNumberValidation.description: Whether to skip phone number validation for this recipient.

useLongCodeForText.description: Whether to use a toll-free long code number for SMS communication.

post.description: Creates a new task in Onfleet.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

destination.description: The ID of the task destination.

recipients[].description: An array containing zero or one recipient IDs.

completeAfter.description: Earliest completion time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

completeBefore.description: Latest completion time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

pickupTask.description: Whether the task is a pickup task.

quantity.description: The number of units to be dropped off while completing this task.

serviceTime.description: The number of minutes a worker should spend on arrival at this task's destination.

recipientName.description: Optional recipient name override for this task only.

recipientNotes.description: Optional recipient notes override for this task only.

recipientSkipSMSNotifications.description: Optional recipient SMS notification override for this task only.
